# Gotchas

<!-- docsync:auto:begin - generated by docsync, edits inside this block are overwritten -->
> **Section status: CURRENT** - reviewed 2026-11-24; not tied to specific files, so it never goes stale.
<!-- docsync:auto:end -->

<!-- The project-wide list of things that surprise people. -->

| # | Gotcha | Why it is like this | Files involved | What goes wrong if ignored |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Every `/api` route needs a rule in `auth/permissions.RULES`, and rule order matters (first match wins) | Deny-by-default policy, shared with the browser | `auth/permissions.py`, `auth/middleware.py`, `frontend-3/src/lib/policy.tsx` | A new endpoint returns 403 for everyone, or a broad rule shadows a specific one (for example `/workflows/executions` must precede `/workflows/<name>`) |
| 2 | Every new workspace-owned model must be registered in `auth/setup.register_scoped_models` | Scoping is an ORM event filter on registered models only | `auth/setup.py`, `auth/scoping.py` | Data leaks between workspaces, or rows lack `workspace_id` |
| 3 | The backend must run as one uvicorn process | Background runs, live executions and the worker supervisor live in-process | `backend/Dockerfile`, `runs/manager.py`, `main.py` | Several workers each start a supervisor; runs are invisible to other processes; streams break |
| 4 | One Temporal worker process per Mistral key, restarted (not reloaded) when modules change | The Workflows SDK reads its key and queue from process-wide environment variables and registers activities globally | `services/mistral_worker.py`, `_worker_inner.py`, `auth/workers.py` | "More than one activity named …" errors; workflows run under the wrong key |
| 5 | `step_runners.run_step` is shared by the local engine and compiled workflows | One behaviour for both executors | `services/workflow_engine/step_runners.py`, `mistral_workflows_compiler.py` | Request-scoped imports break the worker; behaviour diverges between local and Mistral runs |
| 6 | The sync Mistral SDK must always run in threads | It blocks the event loop | `core/decision.py`, `services/sdk_offload.py` | A long planning call freezes the whole API |
| 7 | Settings-page overrides beat `.env` | `apply_overrides` runs after the env load | `config.py`, `app_settings/store.py` | Editing `.env` "does nothing" because an override is saved |
| 8 | Codestral is silently replaced on code roles | Quality decision | `llm_routes.py`, `tool-service/app/llm/routes.py` | Configuring Codestral appears to be ignored |
| 9 | `VAULT_MASTER_KEYS` also encrypts workspace Mistral keys | Shared crypto | `vault/crypto.py`, `auth/mistral_keys.py` | Losing the key locks every workspace, not just the vault |
| 10 | The Vite dev server runs on 8080, not 5173 | The Lovable config forces 8080 | `frontend-3/vite.config.ts`, `@lovable.dev/vite-tanstack-config` | Following the README's 5173 fails; the `CORS_ORIGINS` default does not include 8080 (fine through the proxy, wrong when called directly) |
| 11 | Do not add Vite plugins that the Lovable config already includes | It bundles TanStack Start, React, Tailwind, paths and Nitro | `frontend-3/vite.config.ts` | Duplicate plugins break the app |
| 12 | `xfwd: true` on the dev proxy is required for sign-in | The same-site check compares Origin with `X-Forwarded-Host` | `vite.config.ts`, `auth/middleware.py` | Writes or sign-in are refused in development |
| 13 | `/health` is both a page and an API | HTML requests get the app; others get the backend | `vite.config.ts`, `deploy/Caddyfile`, `main.py` | The health page shows JSON, or the health fetch gets HTML |
| 14 | Caddy must not buffer `/api` (`flush_interval -1`, `read_timeout 0`) | SSE streams for runs and executions | `deploy/Caddyfile` | Progress arrives all at once at the end, or streams are cut |
| 15 | Schema changes must be additive | No migration tool; start-up `ensure_schema` only adds columns | `db_setup.py`, `*/schema.py` | Renames or drops break old databases and rollbacks |
| 16 | The workflow engine has its own SQLAlchemy engine and Base on the same database | Historical separation | `services/workflow_engine/engine.py`, `auth/scoping._engine_for` | Scoping or migrations aimed at the main engine miss the workflow tables |
| 17 | Executions are never sent twice to the Tool Service; only connect failures are retried | Tools may have side effects | `services/tool_resolver.py` | Duplicate emails or writes on retry |
| 18 | A 428 from `/execute` lists the secrets a tool needs; the backend resolves them from the vault and retries once | The Tool Service never stores user secrets | `tool_resolver.py`, `tool-service/app/routes/execution.py`, `vault/*` | Tools fail with missing credentials, or secrets leak into the Tool Service environment |
| 19 | Pipeline stage labels and event names are user-visible and read by the frontend | The UI renders the backend's timeline | `layers/__init__.py`, `core/events.py`, `frontend-3/src/components/pipeline/*` | Timelines show raw ids or break |
| 20 | Fallback model must differ from the primary | Hedging to the same model is pointless | `llm_routes.other_model` | Hedges and fallbacks do nothing |
| 21 | Specific `reasoning_effort` rejection strings are detected verbatim | Models differ in effort support | `core/decision.py` | Calls fail instead of retrying without effort |
| 22 | The Tool Service runs as root in its container | It must demote sandbox subprocesses to `sandboxuser` | `tool-service/Dockerfile`, `synthesis/sandbox.py` | Without root the sandbox cannot drop privileges; approved code runs as root at execution time |
| 23 | Deleted workflow names are remembered in `deleted_workflows` | Mistral keeps archived copies that the list would otherwise show again | `services/workflow_engine/engine.py` | Deleted workflows reappear as "remote-only" |
| 24 | The backend writes compiled workflows into the repository checkout in production | The worker and compiled modules find each other by `../` paths | `deploy/docker-compose.yml`, `deploy.sh`, `backend/Dockerfile` | Permission errors (uid 10001) or workflows not found |
| 25 | Uploads and documents are guarded by Caddy `forward_auth` to `/api/auth/check` | Static files bypass the backend middleware | `deploy/Caddyfile`, `routes/auth.py` | Files are public in production if the rule is removed |
| 26 | The frontend's localStorage stores are per browser, not per user | Simplicity | `frontend-3/src/stores/*` | Another user on the same browser sees run history ids (the server still enforces access) |
| 27 | `backend/.env.example` and the code disagree on `MISTRAL_WORKER_ENABLED` and `CORS_ORIGINS` ordering | The template was written for development | `backend/.env.example`, `config.py` | The worker silently off after copying the template |
| 28 | Auto-approve defaults differ: backend True, Tool Service False | Plans must not block on a review queue; the service alone is conservative | both configs | Confusion about why tools are active or pending |
